This Entry is the Agent-facing usage specification for the completed `snl` CLI. Its child command Entries are normative: each states when an Agent should invoke a command, the required safety sequence, and how machine-readable results drive the next action.

The physical `SKILL.md` is an implementation of this SNL specification, not its authority. Generate or revise that file from these Entries only after the user-side workflow stabilizes. Product behavior and implementation requirements belong to the separate CLI Tools Library.
